follow-on: the positive-control paragraph cites planted_control.log, which fails the gate-log contract twice over: its command header records the literal placeholder `grep -rEn '<search A pattern>' scratch/planted_reader.py` rather than the search pattern, so the control cannot be re-run from its own log (negative_control.log by contrast carries a full literal command), and its last line is `B count: 3` rather than a bare `EXIT=<n>` sentinel, so a reader cannot tell a completed control from a truncated one. The control also ran against scratch/planted_reader.py rather than over the stated nova/ scripts/ packages/ population. The result itself stands — re-running both stated patterns on that file returns exactly the three A lines (6, 7, 10) and three B lines (8, 9, 10) the record claims — but the recorded command does not reproduce it.
